Table 2. Percent Holding Debt for Households, by Type of Debt and States: 2019

NOTE: Sample excludes group quarters and households in which the household reference person was either living outside the United States in December, living in institutionalized group quarters in December, or was living in a non-permanent accommodation in December. Number of households has been rounded to four significant digits. (D) - Cell suppressed due to a small number of observations. 'Total Secured Debt' includes debt on rental property and real estate in addition to home, vehicle, and business debt. 'Total Unsecured Debt' includes credit card debt, student loans, medical debt, and other debt (such as loans obtained through a bank or credit union, money owed to private individuals, or debt held against mutual funds or stocks). The Census Bureau's Statistical Quality Standards indicate that serious data quality issues related to sampling error occur when the estimated coefficients of variation (defined as a standard error divided by its point estimate) for the majority of the key estimates are larger than 0.3.
